full_prompt_en: The image is a black-and-white cinematic photographic close-up of a woman peering over dark patterned fabric against a nearly black background. Around the top and right edges, deep shadow conceals the setting. At the far left, a small, blurred fragment of another face emerges from the darkness, with the rest of the head and body hidden. The main woman fills the centre and right, her head lowered slightly and her wide eyes directed toward the viewer. Dark hair sweeps back from a broad pale forehead, with loose fine strands and scattered silver highlights breaking into the surrounding black. Her sharply defined eyes have dark irises, small reflections, heavy upper lashes and shaded lower lids. The nose bridge and narrow areas beneath the eyes remain visible, while the mouth, chin and lower nose disappear behind the foreground covering. Across the lower third, dark fabric rises in an uneven ridge and carries intricate raised curling patterns, clearest on the left where light catches their textured relief. The covering grows softer and darker toward the bottom-right corner, separating it from the crisply focused eyes. Directional light from the upper left brightens the forehead, nose bridge and portions of the cheeks, leaving a strong central facial shadow and deep darkness at the outer contours. Fine grain and gently softened transitions give the image a vintage photographic surface. The overall composition concentrates pale facial planes between black surroundings and the textured lower band, creating an intimate, watchful atmosphere through tight cropping and selective focus.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅黑白电影式摄影特写，女子从深色纹样织物上方探出目光，背景近乎全黑。上缘及右缘周围，深影隐藏了具体环境。最左侧，一小部分模糊的另一张面孔从暗处浮出，其余头部和身体均被遮住。主要女子占据中央与右侧，头略低，大睁的眼睛朝向观者。深色头发从宽阔明亮的额头向后梳起，细散发丝及零星银色亮痕穿入周围暗色。清楚聚焦的双眼带深色虹膜、小反光点、浓密上睫毛和阴影中的下眼睑。鼻梁与眼下狭窄区域露出，嘴、下巴及鼻部下端则隐藏在前景覆盖物后。画面下方三分之一处，深色织物隆起成不规则边缘，表面有繁复的凸起卷曲纹样，左侧受光处的纹理起伏最清晰。覆盖物向右下角逐渐变软、变暗，与清楚锐利的眼睛拉开焦点层次。来自左上方的定向光照亮额头、鼻梁及部分面颊，在面部中央留下强烈阴影，并使外侧轮廓沉入深暗。细颗粒和柔化的过渡呈现出老电影般的摄影表面。整体在黑色环境与下方纹理横带之间集中浅色面部色面，以紧密裁切和选择性聚焦形成亲近而警觉的气氛。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome photographic treatment uses extreme cropping, selective illumination and deep shadow to reduce detail to a few decisive shapes. Bright tonal accents gather in a narrow focal area, while surrounding values fall rapidly toward black. Soft grain and blurred transitions soften selected edges without weakening the overall graphic separation. Large dark regions act as negative space and make small highlights appear more intense. The composition favors asymmetry and partial concealment, allowing a restricted field of light to guide attention. The overall effect is tense and intimate, built from contrast, omission and carefully controlled focus.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白摄影处理运用极近裁切、选择性照明与深重阴影，将细节压缩为少数决定性形状。明亮调性聚集在狭窄焦点区，周围明度则迅速沉入黑暗。柔和颗粒与模糊过渡让部分边缘变软，却不削弱整体图形分离。大面积暗部成为负空间，使小块高光显得更加鲜明。构图偏向不对称和局部遮挡，让有限光域引导视线。整体效果紧张而亲密，建立在反差、省略与精确控制的焦点之上。
theme_en: A woman peers over dark patterned fabric in a tightly cropped black-and-white close-up.
theme_zh: 女子从深色纹样织物上方望向观者，形成紧密裁切的黑白特写。
name: Mario Bava
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
